_: The crystalline lens: ~4 mm thick, ~10 mm across, an elastic capsule around a soft cortex and nucleus of tightly packed protein fibres; graded index (core 1.406-1.409). Soft and accommodating when young, stiffening ~100x by the 50s (presbyopia). Values for an adult with age laws given. Eye-and-hair materials lane, 2026-11-07.

alpha.src: capsule surface smooth (Purkinje III/IV images are sharp)

absorption.v: clear when young; yellows with age (blue transmission falls), absorbs UV < ~400 nm in adults

kinetic.src: not found; contacts are the iris margin and zonules, in aqueous

phase.src: very soft hyperelastic body in a stiff capsule

collision_thickness_mm.src: numerical skin; capsule itself 5-20 um (not separately modelled here)

contact_stiffness_kPa_per_mm.src: E = 3G with G ~1.4 kPa at 43 y (WILDE12) over ~4 mm: the capsule (MPa) dominates real contact

response_time_ms.src: accommodation responds in ~0.3-0.5 s (physiology, recalled); E: recalled, not re-read

model.src: WILDE12 inverse analyses use a near-incompressible neo-Hookean body; nucleus and cortex as two materials (Model D)

v.form: G = c exp(b (A - A*)), b = b1 for A <= A*, b2 above

capsule_E_kPa.src: FISHER69 abstract re-read 11-08: capsule Young's modulus ~6e7 dyn/cm2 (6 MPa) in childhood, 3 MPa at 60, 1.5 MPa in extreme old age; Poisson ~0.47
